annotations.title: Start a strategy on a paper box

description: Start a strategy on a Hyperliquid paper box: it runs around the clock with no client connected, in simulation only. No key needed, the box URL authorises it, so a trial box from create_ironbox works. kind is breakout (size_usd, lookback_bars, exit_bars, bar_seconds), grid (lower_px, upper_px, grids, size_usd) or dca (tranche_usd, budget_usd, dip_pct, interval_minutes, take_profit_pct, repeat). Every kind needs market and max_loss_usd: when the net loss reaches it, the strategy closes its position and stops. At most 3 per box, one per market. Follow it with get_box_activity.

box.description: The paper box: its base_url from create_ironbox, or the ibxs_ secret

budget_usd.description: dca: total notional across the cycle

dip_pct.description: dca: move against the last entry that buys the next tranche, default 3

exit_bars.description: breakout: exit channel, default half of lookback_bars

interval_minutes.description: dca: also buy a tranche after this long

leverage.description: Cross leverage on this market, default 3

lookback_bars.description: breakout: entry channel, 5 to 120 bars, default 20

market.description: A live main perp, by display symbol or Hyperliquid name, e.g. BTC-PERP or BTC

max_loss_usd.description: Net loss in USD that stops the strategy (required)

repeat.description: dca: start a new cycle after a take profit

side.description: breakout: long, short or both (default both). grid and dca: long (default) or short

size_usd.description: breakout: notional of each entry. grid: total across the ladder, at least 10 a level

take_profit_pct.description: dca: close the stack at this gain on the average entry

name: start_box_strategy

notice.description: Present when the API added a note: how a market name was read, that data starts later than asked because of the history window, or a next step such as a free key

strategy.description: One strategy on a paper box

pnl_usd.description: Net result: realized plus unrealized plus funding minus fees

position.description: Its share of the box's position, signed

stop_reason.description: max_loss, take_profit, liquidated, order_rejected, stopped_by_user, box_reset or box_deleted; null while running

title: Start a strategy on a paper box
